scientific_integrity: The exact result is supported by the stated analytic argument and reproduced finite checks; originality was assessed against accessible primary and published comparator texts, and independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats one canonical split quadratic form and the coordinate Walsh band of degree at most two.
Earlier formulations using association schemes or punctured Reed-Muller codes might contain equivalent spectral information.
Computational checks cover four finite parameter values and are not the universal proof.
title: Complete quadratic Walsh sampling spectrum on a split binary quadric
